Taylor expansion at panel midpoint with controlled O(c^{beta-4}) remainder establishes v_k=beta²(beta-1)² c^{2beta-4}/720+O(c^{2beta-6}), giving the summable, harmonic-log and power-sum cases. Unbiasedness, infinite variance threshold, independent comparator, monotone rearrangement optimum and smooth C² limit are proved with domain restrictions. Exact closed forms at beta=2,3 and 552 deterministic checks corroborate the algebra; finite checks do not replace proofs.
